identity.name: PINDER-S
identity.primary_subset: 93 PINDER-S cases with paired apo structures

found_basis: Public PINDER source, documented installation, executable pinder_eval CLI and public structural inputs establish an executable benchmark. This does not establish a working optimized docking-method installation.

outcome_definition.ranking_and_search: Report rank-1 separately from best DockQ among a fixed candidate count. Neither is a claim of affinity or biological efficacy.
outcome_definition.published_performance_values_reason: No independently published method performance table was verified in this bounded intake.

citations.title: PINDER: The Protein INteraction Dataset and Evaluation Resource

source_licences.item: PINDER source code and evaluation harness
source_licences.reason: Repository distributes LICENSE; fetched licence does not explicitly identify external dataset files as covered.

source_licences.item: PINDER 2024-02 derived structures, index and metadata
source_licences.reason: No explicit terms covering externally hosted derived dataset were established in the bounded source inspection. Repository code licence alone does not establish coverage.
wwPDB usage policy explicitly covers data files contained in the PDB archive.

intended_use.description: Scientific docking evaluation and parallel search experiments requested by brief
intended_use.reason: External PINDER dataset terms not established. Public access is not proof of permission.

evidence.fact: PINDER requires Python >=3.10 and depends on torch, biotite, fastpdb and scientific Python packages.
fastpdb wheels on Linux require glibc >=2.34; otherwise Rust compilation is required.
Physics docking software must be obtained separately; PINDER does not provide that software.

stock_cuda_image.reason: Stock image definition, installed dependencies, docking executable and reproduction are unverified. CPU evaluator has no demonstrated CUDA incompatibility; feasibility remains unknown.

footprint.reason: Published full-release and test archive sizes are not a measured footprint of the selected 93-case docking workload; peak working set is unpublished in inspected sources.

scoring.decoys: Two chains R and L; rank encoded in final digits of model filename.
outputs: per-decoy DockQ, iRMS, LRMS, Fnat and CAPRI
scoring.caution: PINDER leaderboard acceptable percentages use CAPRI classes; compute the brief's DockQ >=0.23 predicate directly from per-decoy DockQ rather than equating those definitions.

repeatability.fixed_scale: All 93 paired-apo PINDER-S cases; no scale search.
repeatability.case_ids_reason: Published subset predicate and count established; individual IDs have not been materialized.
repeatability.seeds_reason: Brief requires independent seeds but supplies no seed values; inspected baseline documentation supplies no seed schedule.
repeatability.candidate_count_basis: Intake fixes five output candidates per case, matching published top-5 evaluation interface. This is an intake choice, not a claimed published docking configuration.
repeatability.protocol: Freeze index content, selected IDs, actual docking configuration, candidate count and independent seeds before execution. Report each repeat; no invented acceptance tolerance.

secondary_challenge.mode: Redocking from separated bound components; not independently determined unbound structures.
secondary_challenge.reason: Biological assembly, capsid representation and chain selection require specification before secondary docking.

search_note: No general benchmark search performed. Only supplied PINDER repository, its linked baseline source, DockQ classification source and PDB data/policy were inspected.
unresolved: Working optimized docking implementation and immutable external-software pin
